'''Bengara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived in the settlement [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Bengara was the proprietor of [[Offworld Trader's]], a luxury goods shop established within an old [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
